source: Emissions Impossible: Methane Edition, dataset workbook (Institute for Agriculture and Trade Policy and Changing Markets Foundation, 15 November 2022)

sheets.name: Contents
rows: This workbook contains estimates for the GHG emissions associated with the supply of livestock products to several meat and dairy companies. The estimates are based on reported or estimated animal processing data for each company, and estimates of average emissions for livestock products from the FAO's GLEAM 2.0 tool.
Summary table of results for all milk and meat companies assessed
Emissions estimates for five major meat processing companies
Emissions estimates for ten major dairy companies
Assumptions for meat and milk processed by each company, with sources
Emission factors for meat and milk production from GLEAM, expressed in terms of GWP100 using values from both IPCC AR5 and AR6, and in terms of GWP20 using values from IPCC AR6
Additional assumptions used in the estimations, including typical animal slaughter weights and dressing precentages and the GWP values used
Countries in each of the regions used in GLEAM 2.0
Comparisons of company methane emissions, underlying data for figures 2 to 4 in the report
Comparisons of emissions based on GWP100 vs. GWP20, underlying data for figures 5 & 6 in the report
Comparisons of company total GHG emissions, underlying data for figures 7 & 8 in the report
